eyebrow: Self-attention: Q, K, V from the same sequence
code:
mha = nn.MultiheadAttention(
    embed_dim=64, num_heads=4, batch_first=True)

x = torch.randn(2, 10, 64)
out, w = mha(x, x, x)
# query = key = value = x
# out: (2, 10, 64)
caption: Every token attends to every other token in its own sequence.

eyebrow: Cross-attention: Q from one, K/V from another
code:
dec = torch.randn(2, 6, 64)    # decoder, tgt_len=6
enc = torch.randn(2, 10, 64)   # encoder, src_len=10

out, w = mha(dec, enc, enc)
# query = dec, key = value = enc
# out: (2, 6, 64) -- matches QUERY length
caption: The decoder looks back at the full encoder output.

steps.label: Self-attention
steps.sub: query = key = value -- one sequence looks at itself

steps.label: Cross-attention
steps.sub: query differs from key/value -- one sequence looks at another

steps.label: Output length
steps.sub: always matches the QUERY's sequence length
